newsitem.title: USA: Crown Casino ends plans to buy CH Medical.
newsitem.headline: Crown Casino ends plans to buy CH Medical.

text.p: Crown Casino Corp said Thursday that it has ended its plans to acquire substantially all the assets and operations of CH Medical Inc, doing business as Cardio Systems.
Crown said it sought to restructure the deal after completing due diligence but it and CH Medical have been unable to come to terms to complete the deal, which was announced in December 1996.
The company said it is still looking for acquisitions, and in the meantime, plans to resume repurchasing its stock in the open market.
It said it has repurchased about 1.3 million shares under a plan previously approved.
The company said it has $36 million in shareholders' equity, of which more than $21 million is in cash, and no debt, and feels it is in a very strong position to complete acquisitions or mergers.
